findings.claim: GBP policy comparisons use decimal pounds with arbitrary fractional-penny precision. The policy validator admits those limits, and the same comparison feeds the main threshold, referral bands and stored-result replay.
findings.repro: Use a custom policy rule on M17 with op >=, threshold 0.301 and on_fail fail. Supply a statement with total money in of £0.30. The policy accepts the fractional-penny limit at src/cma/policy.py:77 and decides the rule using Decimal('0.30') >= Decimal('0.301'). The passing contract test checks a whole-penny threshold and only establishes that policy calls the figures layer.

findings.claim: When the same record contains an oversized field and a separate invalid UTF-8 cell, recovery detects the invalid cell to exclude it from the readable set but drops the encoding diagnostic from the statement refusal.
findings.repro: Use the header id,date,description,amount,balance,extra. On line 2 put T1,2026-01-01, then a description of 200,000 ASCII characters, then ,1.00,1.00, followed by raw byte 0xFF in the extra cell. The loader reports the oversized description on line 2 and omits the invalid UTF-8 found in that same record.
